function.name: get_player_info
function.description: Get player information from MineBridge API by nickname or Telegram ID

function.name: get_server_status
function.description: Get Minecraft server status (online, players, version, etc)

function.name: get_stickers
function.description: Get list of available stickers. You can sometimes use sticker: [[sticker:name]]

function.name: get_news
function.description: Get latest news from MineBridge news feed

limit.description: Number of news items to fetch (default: 5, max: 15)

function.name: get_events
function.description: Get events for a specific season

season.description: Season number (-1 for latest season (default), 1 for first season)

limit.description: Number of players to fetch (default: 5, max: 15)

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for current information, news, or any topic. Use this when you need up-to-date information or facts not in your knowledge base.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, max: 10)
